meta_description: DMC Plastering & Rendering in Manchester. Expert interior and exterior plastering, rendering, and skimming. Free quotes available. Call 07544 762366.
hero_subhead: From cracked walls to complete renders, we deliver smooth, durable finishes that transform your property.
services_heading: Complete Plastering & Rendering Services Across Manchester
services_subhead: Whether you need interior skimming, external rendering, or repair work, we handle every job with precision and care.

services.title: Internal Plastering & Skimming
services.desc: Smooth, perfectly finished walls and ceilings ready for decoration. We repair old plaster, apply fresh basecoats, and deliver flawless skimmed finishes that last.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Durable weather-resistant renders that protect and beautify your home's exterior. We use quality materials and proven techniques to ensure long-lasting protection against Manchester's climate.

services.title: Crack Repair & Repointing
services.desc: We identify the cause of cracks, repair structural issues properly, and repoint brickwork to stop water ingress and restore structural integrity.

services.title: Textured Coatings & Finishes
services.desc: Textured renders, pebbledash, and decorative finishes that add character and durability to your property's exterior.

services.title: Damp Proofing & Preparation
services.desc: Pre-plaster treatment for damp walls, including tanking and moisture barriers to ensure your new plaster stays dry and sound.

services.title: Commercial & Residential Work
services.desc: From domestic extensions to commercial projects, we work on properties of all sizes with the same attention to detail and professional standards.

about_pullquote: We do the job once, properly. No shortcuts, no call-backs.
about_para_1: DMC Plastering & Rendering has been serving Manchester homeowners and businesses for over 15 years. We started because we saw too many plasterers cutting corners and leaving customers with cracked, poorly finished walls. Our approach is simple: use quality materials, take time to prepare surfaces correctly, and deliver finishes that stay flawless for years.
about_para_2: We've built a reputation for reliability, attention to detail, and honest pricing. Our customers come back to us because we turn up on time, complete work as promised, and stand behind every job. Whether it's a small crack repair or a full house rendering, we treat it with the same care and professionalism.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Customers Say About DMC Plastering

reviews.text: Had the whole front of our Victorian terrace rendered and they made a brilliant job of it. Professional from start to finish, site kept clean, and they explained everything before they started. Would absolutely recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Our bathroom ceiling had a nasty damp patch and the previous plasterer's work was falling off. DMC came out, sorted the damp issue properly, and re-skimmed the whole ceiling. Looks perfect and no more damage. Honest lads, fair price.
reviews.author: Christine P.

reviews.text: Called for a quote on a crack in the living room wall that was getting worse. They came out same week, diagnosed the issue, and fixed it permanently. Three months on, no cracks returning. Really impressed with their professionalism.
reviews.author: David L.
